already_at_center_tolerance.note: at or inside this tolerance the demo reports ALREADY_AT_CENTER and sends nothing

arrival_tolerance.note: same contract check_center enforces for the named center

ik_seed_note: Control tries the CURRENT joints first; these two are the physical center branches seen with controller tool tcp3 (2026-11-04) and with the earlier tool 1. Seeds never widen the goal, they only steer IK branch selection.
motion_api_authorization_note: canonical_backend validates /api/operations/execute against exactly this phrase; the operator-facing phrase above is what the demo itself requires on the command line.
notes: Goal is a BODY TCP pose; the controller tool (tool_id/tcp) is read live per run and recorded, never hardcoded.
Every run plans fresh (FORCE_RESCAN) and dispatches within the 300 s plan window; old plans are never reused.
Site ceiling is asserted from config/jaka_mini2_motion.site.json; if it is not the required 0.2 the demo refuses instead of silently running slower.
